title: SM70V2 7" Display Dual Camera Baby Monitor with Temperature Sensor US$94.90 (~A$136.56) Delivered @ MBOSS via AliExpress
body:
Deal: SM70V2 7" Display Dual Camera Baby Monitor with Temperature Sensor US$94.90 (~A$136.56) Delivered @ MBOSS via AliExpress

[ericshurn] These are great, my only complaint is I wish the battery life on the monitor was a bit better
[ONEMariachi] Yeah agreed. Pretty much need it plugged it to last the night i’ve found. Which isn’t a big deal but is definitely something that could be improved. It’s a fantastic monitor outside of that.
[tomwhiteallnight] I got this because a few has recommended it on ozb. The issue we had was the picture would freeze once in a while (infrequently) randomly and toggling between the two cameras on the monitor would make it live again. I was gonna return it, aliexpreessed offered a partial refund for me to keep it as an alternative (I could of returned and got a full refund), so we did that. Now we just put up with it, and it doesn't happen very often.
The wife use it mostly, when it's my turn, I just listen for the sound and sort it since the baby room is adjacent to our roof.
[Yosan] Could it be happening when you use some appliances like a microwave oven?
[tomwhiteallnight] Nah, this was like in our bedroom about 4 metres away. Only signals would be phone wifi to the router probably.
[PainToad] I have an IR blaster in the room and have Home Assistant set it to send a random IR command every second.
IR light shows up the camera but is invisible to eyes in the room.
If the flashing on the camera stops, it means the video has frozen.
That said I’ve never had this one freeze. Only a Tapo one.
[ONEMariachi] Had mine for 8 months and not had this issue. So likely you got a faulty one
[chillybags] We have this - we found it to be great we even re-bought it after our first one broke (due to a relative accidentally sat on the monitor and it wouldnt turn on).
Vox function works well. We love the USB C for the monitor which is an improvement on the sm50 version which is a bit cheaper.
[Spawn Peak] I am getting US $104.40 at checkout. $12.28 GST, same promo code. How are you getting it cheaper? I don't have the coins but that shouldn't cover that entire difference.
[Salesniper] Could try pressing collect all promo codes on the AliExpress Home Screen? I’ve checked again and still get the same price from this deal.
This seller does have two of this camera, one has branding on it, you’re not trying to checkout that one?
[BlueGlowOne] 👍🏻
I use both TP-Link which requires a good connection and has the advantage of iPad, iPhone and VLC streaming on PC.
These are great due to pricing versus similar branded models, stable connection and easy to take on holidays. I use it mainly for the stability and microphone pickup overnight however one nice bonus is the much stronger IR light versus the TP-Link cameras is great for boosting the latter in the darkness.
[PainToad] The point of these is they can’t be hacked by someone on the other side of the planet. No connection to the internet.
[A Banana4scale] what you think is an advantage is the exact reason I have gone for the non internet one.
Don't want to scare you but all of these internet connected devices can be/will be hacked and the contents can get streamed live or stored for nefarious purposes. What I am saying is not a conspiracy theory, there are multiple websites dedicated to live streaming hacked/open CCTV, security cams, web cams, doorbells etc.
[Aguynamedlance] I have a Tweety cam and the in-laws have one of these.
The Tweety can is better;
* Image quality is better, the monitor has a purple hue, and the cameras are grainy. (Yes even when mixed)
* Tweety cam monitor is USB-C so it's easy to charge with existing phone chargers.
* The camera cable is USB-A on the wall end, so you can use a power bank. (Good for naps during Xmas lunch or weddings)
Edit: if you're using it everyday get the Tweety cam, if it's once a week or less get this
[PainToad] Your in-laws don’t have this then. Or you’re actually the owner of Tweety Cam and there are no in-laws.
This is the newer model of the product Tweety Cam is rebadging and adding mark up to.
This version has a bigger screen. Higher resolution (1080p vs 720p).
Tweety cam monitor is USB-C
So is this.
The camera cable is USB-A on the wall end
Again, so does this.
Ignore this person.
[gamer9119] How accurate is the temperature sensor? And does it measure ambient room temperature, or baby temperature?
Temperature is the only useful feature that is better than a $30 indoors camera with motion tracking.
